title: AnyStake
tagline: 🚀 AnyStake: Cross-chain staking dApp—stake any token on any chain, earn rewards everywhere!
description:
AnyStake is a next-generation decentralized application (dApp) that enables seamless cross-chain staking, allowing users to stake tokens across multiple EVM-compatible blockchains (e.g., Ethereum, Hedera, Flow) from a single interface. 

Unlike traditional staking platforms limited to single-chain assets, AnyStake leverages LayerZero for secure cross-chain messaging and plan to use Pyth Network for real-time APY and staking data, ensuring optimal yields and interoperability.
how_its_made:
Stacking all kinds of technology is not our style. Instead, we try to provide a platform which benifits users by featuring a user-friendly dashboard with multi-wallet support (MetaMask, WalletConnect), real-time reward tracking, and one-click cross-chain claims—eliminating liquidity fragmentation while maintaining security through non-custodial smart contracts.

The project uses ConnectKit as a UI wrapper around WalletConnect v2, which simplifies the implementation while maintaining all the benefits of WalletConnect v2's architecture.
